name.en: Slide Deck, Web UI & Graphic Layout
name.zh: 演示文稿、Web 界面与平面视觉

summary.en: Flags PowerPoint and PDF slide word-walls, autofit text shrink, generic titles, Web UI neon gradients, glow orbs, emoji chrome, icon-tile grids, SVG layout defects, and raster image AI workflow/palette slop.
summary.zh: 检查 PPT 与横版 PDF 文字墙、自动缩排、空泛标题，以及网页里的紫粉渐变、霓虹光球、Emoji 图标堆砌、模板卡格、SVG 排版缺陷和图片工作流残留与塑料配色。

message.en: Slide exceeds readable copy budget (> 120 Latin words or > 280 Chinese characters).
message.zh: 单页幻灯片可见文字超载（英文 > 120 词或中文 > 280 字），变成文档搬家。

deletionTest.en: Move background narrative to speaker notes or an appendix doc; keep one takeaway headline and <= 3 supporting evidence points on the slide.
deletionTest.zh: 将长篇背景移入演讲者备注或配套文档，画面仅保留 1 句结论标题与不超过 3 条核心论据。

exemplar.bad: Slide 3 packs 215 words of full-sentence prose explaining migration history, rollback scripts, staffing, and Q4 SLA targets.
exemplar.trap: Slide 3 shrinks body font to 9pt so all 215 words fit inside one rounded box.
exemplar.good: Slide 3 headline: 'Zero-downtime migration cut p99 latency from 420 ms to 95 ms' + 3 short metric rows (54 words total); full runbook linked in notes.

note.en: State the conclusion in the slide title and move prose paragraphs into speaker notes.
note.zh: 用结论句做标题，长段落移入备注栏而非缩小字号硬塞。

message.en: Slide contains more than 6 bullet items (`maxSlideBullets`), fragmenting visual hierarchy.
message.zh: 单页幻灯片项目符号超过 6 条（`maxSlideBullets`），视觉层级碎裂。

deletionTest.en: Group related bullets into 2–3 structured columns or split across two slides.
deletionTest.zh: 将零散条目归并为 2–3 组结构化分栏，或拆分为两页演示。

exemplar.bad: Slide lists 9 separate top-level bullets covering pricing, onboarding, compliance, SLA, and billing.
exemplar.trap: Slide wraps 9 bullets into 9 tiny pill badges.
exemplar.good: Slide groups commercial terms into 3 columns: Pricing ($49/seat), Onboarding (2 days), SLA (99.95%).

note.en: Keep all 3 commercial numbers while capping list items per slide at <= 6.
note.zh: 保留全部商业数字，将单页列表控制在 6 条以内。

message.en: PowerPoint `normAutofit` shrank text below 80% (`fontScale < 80000`) because copy overflowed its box.
message.zh: 文本框触发 PowerPoint 自动缩排（`fontScale < 80%`），表明文案超出容器容量。

deletionTest.en: Trim the overflowing copy or enlarge the text frame so body type renders at 100% scale.
deletionTest.zh: 精简溢出文案或调大文本框尺寸，使正文按 100% 原始字号清晰排布。

exemplar.trap: Manually hardcode 10pt font so `normAutofit` disappears while text stays illegible.
exemplar.good: <a:noAutofit/> with 42 words set at 18pt and full line spacing

note.en: Autofit below 80% is deterministic proof that text did not fit its layout frame.
note.zh: 低于 80% 的自动缩排是文案撑破版面的确定性证据。

message.en: Content-heavy slide uses a generic topic label ('Overview', 'Background', '背景') instead of stating its takeaway.
message.zh: 正文密集的幻灯片使用“背景/概述/总结”等空泛名词做标题，未直接亮出本页结论。

deletionTest.en: Replace 'Overview' with the one-sentence finding the audience should remember from this slide.
deletionTest.zh: 把“项目背景/数据概述”替换为听众看完本页应记住的一句具体结论。

exemplar.bad: Title: 'Background' (above 65 words detailing 38% cart abandonment on mobile Safari)
exemplar.good: Title: 'Mobile Safari accounts for 38% of cart abandonment due to 4-step address entry'

note.en: Section dividers with <= 12 words are exempt; dense content slides benefit from assertion titles.
note.zh: 少于 12 词的章节过渡页豁免；高信息量内容页建议采用结论式标题。

clean: PPTX_STRONG_TITLE:Cache hit ratio reached 94% after key sharding

message.en: Default purple/indigo-to-pink generator gradient or gradient-clipped display headline.
message.zh: 使用默认紫粉/蓝紫高饱和渐变或渐变裁切艺术字标题（典型生成式模板特征）。

deletionTest.en: Replace decorative neon gradients with solid surface tokens, crisp 1px rules, and typographic contrast.
deletionTest.zh: 去掉装饰性霓虹渐变，改用克制的纯色纸面令牌、1px 结构分界线与字重对比。

exemplar.bad: Release Notes v2.4
exemplar.trap: Release Notes v2.4

note.en: Swapping purple-pink for teal-cyan gradient text repeats the same template habit; set headlines in solid high-contrast ink.
note.zh: 把紫粉渐变换成青蓝渐变字仍是同一模板套路；正文标题应使用高对比度纯色墨迹。

message.en: Excessive `rounded-full` / `999px` text pills (> 6 per view) turn interface metadata into badge soup.
message.zh: 单视图堆砌超过 6 个胶囊圆角文字标签（`rounded-full` / `999px`），导致视觉噪音泛滥。

deletionTest.en: Render metadata as plain tabular text separated by middots (`·`) or hairlines; save one high-contrast label for actionable status.
deletionTest.zh: 将常规元数据改为用间隔号（`·`）或细线分隔的纯文本，仅对需要干预的异常状态保留单枚强调标记。

exemplar.trap: 8 square pastel badges with 8 emoji icons on one card.
exemplar.good: Plain mono metadata line: `v2.4 · us-west-2 · SOC2` + single status word `degraded` when unhealthy.

note.en: Circular avatars and icon-only buttons are exempt; text-bearing pills are counted.
note.zh: 圆形头像与纯图标按钮豁免，仅统计带文字的胶囊标签。

hit: Tag 1Tag 2Tag 3Tag 4Tag 5Tag 6Tag 7

message.en: Three or more nested bordered/rounded containers wrap the same content (`box-in-box-in-box`).
message.zh: 连续三层及以上带边框与圆角的容器层层套盒，挤压有效内容空间。

deletionTest.en: Remove outer wrapper borders and separate sections with alignment, whitespace, or a single 1px rule.
deletionTest.zh: 去掉多余的外层描边套盒，改用对齐、留白或单根 1px 分界线组织层级。

exemplar.bad: 99.98% uptime
exemplar.trap: 99.98% uptime

note.en: One container boundary or hairline rule is enough to group a metric.
note.zh: 一层边界或一根分隔细线足以建立视觉分组。

hit: Nested
clean: Clean single card

patterns: \b(?:AI-Powered|Powered by AI|Next-Gen AI|Zero Hallucinations?|100% Hallucination-Free|Supercharge Your Workflow|Unleash the Power of AI)\b
(?:AI\s*强力驱动|零幻觉保证|开启智能新时代|颠覆式智能体验)

message.en: Interface chrome echoes prompt-engineering hype ('AI-Powered', 'Zero Hallucination') instead of naming the function.
message.zh: 界面标签直接回显提示词营销口号（如“AI 强力驱动”“零幻觉保证”），未说明具体功能。

deletionTest.en: Delete the 'AI-Powered' badge; label the control by the exact task it performs ('Extract invoice totals', 'Check slide word count').
deletionTest.zh: 删去“AI 驱动”装饰标牌，直接用控件完成的实际动作命名（如“核对幻灯片字数”）。

exemplar.trap:
Built for Craft · Pure Signal

Document Checker
exemplar.good: Document Linter for Markdown, HTML, DOCX & PPTX

note.en: Name the supported file formats instead of boasting about intelligence.
note.zh: 直接列出支持的文件格式，不贴自我标榜的口号签。

message.en: Decorative ambient blur orbs (`blur-3xl`), neon box-shadows, pulsing `animate-ping` pill dots, or heavy SVG glow filters.
message.zh: 堆砌装饰性环境光晕球（`blur-3xl`）、霓虹色阴影、闪烁 `animate-ping` 小圆点或重度 SVG 发光滤镜。

deletionTest.en: Delete decorative blur orbs and colored glow shadows; separate layers with solid surface tokens and crisp 1px borders.
deletionTest.zh: 删掉无功能的光晕球和霓虹发光阴影，改用单调阶梯底色和 1px 实线分隔层次。

note.en: Swapping purple glow for teal glow repeats the same decorative haze; use solid ink contrast.
note.zh: 把紫色光晕换成青色光晕还是同一种发光套路，直接去掉模糊光斑即可。

message.en: Three or more decorative AI stock emojis (`🚀`, `✨`, `⚡`, `🛡️`) used as interface or heading icons.
message.zh: 在界面标题、按钮或卡片里堆砌 3 处及以上通用 Emoji（如 `🚀`、`✨`、`⚡`、`🛡️`）充当图标。

deletionTest.en: Strip decorative emojis from headings and controls; use plain typography or a consistent single-stroke SVG icon set.
deletionTest.zh: 删去标题与按钮里的装饰 Emoji，改用纯文字层级或统一线宽的单色矢量图标。

note.en: Swapping rockets for sparkles and gems still looks like generated filler; plain concrete headings read faster.
note.zh: 把火箭换成星星和钻石仍是生成式拼贴味，直接用具体小标题更利落。

message.en: Stock generator UI boilerplate: tinted rounded-square icon tiles (>= 3), fake macOS 3-dot window chrome, or sequential `01`/`02`/`03` eyebrow kickers.
message.zh: 命中生成式界面三大件：彩色圆角方块图标卡（>= 3 组）、假 macOS 三色窗口圆点或 `01`/`02`/`03` 编号眉题。

deletionTest.en: Remove fake window dots, sequential numeric kickers, and tinted icon tiles; organize cards with real headings and alignment.
deletionTest.zh: 删去假窗口圆点、编号眉题和马卡龙图标块，靠真实小标题和对齐建立网格秩序。

exemplar.bad:
A
B
C
exemplar.good:
CLI

Checks Markdown and PPTX locally.

MCP

Connects to coding agents.

note.en: Replacing tinted icon tiles with `01`/`02`/`03` kickers swaps one boilerplate chrome for another.
note.zh: 把彩色图标块换成 `01`/`02`/`03` 编号眉题只是换了另一种模板壳。

message.en: SVG graphic has structural generation defects: missing `viewBox` on a large canvas, overlapping `<text>` coordinates, or >= 2 orphaned `<defs>` entries.
message.zh: SVG 平面图形存在生成式结构缺陷：大画布缺失 `viewBox`、文字坐标重叠或 `<defs>` 中残留 2 处及以上孤立未用定义。

deletionTest.en: Add an explicit `viewBox`, separate `<text>` coordinates cleanly, and delete unused gradients or filters from `<defs>`.
deletionTest.zh: 补齐显式 `viewBox`，拉开重叠文字坐标，并清理 `<defs>` 里未被引用的冗余渐变与滤镜。

exemplar.bad: <svg width="640" height="360"><text x="40" y="50">Step 1</text><text x="42" y="52">Overlap</text></svg>
exemplar.trap: <svg viewBox="0 0 640 360" width="640" height="360"><defs><linearGradient id="u1"/><linearGradient id="u2"/></defs><rect width="640" height="360"/></svg>
exemplar.good: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 640 360" width="640" height="360"><text x="40" y="50">Step 1</text><text x="40" y="96">Step 2</text></svg>

note.en: Non-icon SVGs need a responsive `viewBox`, non-overlapping text coordinates, and zero orphaned `<defs>` bloat.
note.zh: 非小图标画布应声明 `viewBox`、保证文字坐标不碰撞，并删去未被引用的 `<defs>`。

clean: <svg viewBox="0 0 400 200" width="400" height="200"><text x="20" y="40">Input</text><text x="20" y="88">Output</text></svg>

message.en: Raster image embeds unstripped AI generation prompt/workflow parameters (warning) or explicit synthetic provenance tags (info — retain required legal disclosures).
message.zh: 图片文件内嵌了未清理的生成提示词/工作流参数（提醒），或带有显式 AI 生成来源标识（提示：合规场景请保留法定标识，重点复核成图质感）。

deletionTest.en: Strip accidental raw prompt/seed workflow JSON before shipping assets; keep legally required C2PA or IPTC `trainedAlgorithmicMedia` disclosures intact.
deletionTest.zh: 交付前清理意外残留的提示词与工作流 JSON；属于法规要求的 C2PA 或 `trainedAlgorithmicMedia` 标识请勿私自剥除，仅作质感复核。

exemplar.bad: PNG tEXt chunk `parameters`: `masterpiece, neon glow\nNegative prompt: blurry\nSteps: 28, Sampler: Euler a, CFG scale: 7`
exemplar.trap: Stripping legal C2PA / `trainedAlgorithmicMedia` provenance tags instead of inspecting or re-shooting the asset
exemplar.good: Clean PNG/JPEG export with raw prompt/node-graph chunks removed and natural photographic or editorial raster assets

note.en: Removing leaked ComfyUI/A1111 prompt strings protects internal workflows; never strip legally mandated AI disclosures.
note.zh: 清理工作流参数块可避免提示词与节点图外泄；面向公众分发的合成图片应依法保留来源标识。

hit: IMG_WORKFLOW:parameters: cyberpunk UI\nNegative prompt: text\nSteps: 30, CFG scale: 7

message.en: PNG pixel profile matches default AI-slop aesthetics: dominant neon purple-indigo-pink palette or hyper-saturated airbrushed plastic sheen.
message.zh: PNG 像素分布呈现典型生成式视觉套路：高占比蓝紫霓虹主色，或大面积高饱和光滑“塑料感”涂抹。

deletionTest.en: Review the rendered image for plastic skin/surfaces or generic neon-purple backdrops; re-grade toward natural micro-contrast and restrained accents.
deletionTest.zh: 人工复核图片是否存在塑料反光质感或默认黑底蓝紫霓虹，改用自然材质细节与克制配色。

exemplar.bad: 1024x1024 dark-mode hero PNG with 42% #0B0B14 dark backdrop and 28% glowing #7C3AED/#EC4899 purple-pink pixels
exemplar.trap: 1024x1024 PNG pushing every surface to 92% saturation with airbrushed zero-texture gradients
exemplar.good: 1024x1024 PNG on #F6F7F5 paper ground with crisp ink typography and <= 5% single vermilion accent

note.en: Pixel heuristics are advisory signals; crisp UI screenshots on neutral grounds stay cleanly below thresholds.
note.zh: 像素分布仅作温和提示，白底或克制暗底的正常 UI 截图不会误报。

message.en: PDF slide/poster layout exhibits synthetic template defects: multi-page raster-only slides, collapsed font hierarchy, crushed < 9.5pt body copy, or 4+ consecutive identical landscape slide skeletons.
message.zh: PDF 演示页或海报存在排版缺陷：多页全图无可选文字、横版页字阶扁平或正文缩至 < 9.5pt，或连续 4 页及以上同骨架纯字横版页。

deletionTest.en: Export slides with selectable vector text, restore a >= 1.2x title-to-body type scale, keep body type >= 11pt, and vary layout structure across slides.
deletionTest.zh: 导出可选择矢量文本而非整页贴图，拉开至少 1.2 倍的标题与正文字号阶梯（正文 >= 11pt），并穿插表格或图表。

exemplar.bad: 4-page landscape 960x540 PDF deck where every slide is a single rasterized PNG image with 0 selectable text operators
exemplar.trap: 4-page landscape PDF deck shrinking all body text to 8.5pt with 10pt titles (1.17x ratio) to cram paragraphs
exemplar.good: 5-page landscape PDF deck with 28pt assertion headlines, 13pt body copy, and alternating tables and charts

note.en: Portrait prose reports and single-page portfolios are exempt from landscape slide density and monotony rules.
note.zh: 竖版长文报告与单页作品集豁免横版幻灯片单调与文字墙检查。
